name: cross.nonstream.anthropic-to-responses-request
description: Cross-protocol: a Anthropic Messages request (system prompt, multiturn text, one tool call with its tool result, tool definition, sampling params, and a metadata field with no IR equivalent) converted to a Responses request through the IR.

input.system: You are a helpful weather assistant.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather for a city.

expected_output.instructions: You are a helpful weather assistant.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather for a city.

expected_losses.detail: Anthropic request metadata (user_id) has no IR equivalent in v1.
Responses requests have no stop-sequences parameter; the IR stop sequences are dropped.
